faction.FrancheComte.desc:
Franche-Comte PS is a corporation specializing in the development and operation of high-end security systems. PS stands for "prison solutions." Its technology is used not only to protect facilities, but also to contain the most dangerous public enemies in the System. Franche-Comte PS provides a full range of services—from the design of security systems to the management of prisons, where each prisoner is under constant and strict control. Its prisons are known as some of the most secure and impregnable, with unique technologies that ensure that prisoners cannot escape even with outside help.

Despite the fact that the corporation can turn any station into a prison and immediately begin to extract profit from it, Franche-Comte PS, like everyone else, does not limit itself only to its main focus. The corporation also employs an elite staff of couriers who specialize in the safe delivery of valuable cargo and sensitive data to the most inaccessible or dangerous places. These couriers are known for their ability to avoid any obstacles, be it competitors, pirate crews or adverse space conditions. The corporation’s slogan describes both types of core services: "Safety guaranteed." Rumor has it that Grasshopper Tek hates Franche-Comte PS for competing in the cargo delivery field.

The history of Franche-Comte PS dates back to the Great Anarchist Revolution, when the disappearance of nation states required new forms of punishment and security. Starting out as a provider of security systems for private prisons, the company quickly became a leading provider of complete prison solutions for a variety of corporate clients. NCE is vague about the status of a prisoner within the AnCap system, but Franche-Comte PS will accept a contract for any “security assurance cargo”. The contract states that the responsibility for what that cargo is lies with the party providing it.
faction.FrancheComte.name: Franche-Comte PS
faction.FrancheComte.shortdesc:
Chairman of the Board : Lucien Rochefort
Headquarters: February (Mechta)

Prison corporation.

faction.GodBuilders.desc:
The God-Builders are a splinter group that broke away from the Civil Resistance. They believe that fighting the anarcho-capitalist system is meaningless without achieving ontological superiority. The God-Builders are convinced that humanity, in its current form, is incapable of defeating the corporations and the quasimorphs. But humanity can be transformed. The figure in whom they saw the path to that transformation is Prometheuths, a quasimorph who descended to Earth 70,000 years ago to gift fire to future humans. And now, he has been carried back into space by Leah.

Prometheuths shows humanity a new path. Perhaps it lies in enhancing the technologies of the Civil Resistance. Perhaps it means reshaping humans into technoconstructs. Perhaps it is the mystical gift of a new fire. But first, Prometheuths points the way to fighting all who stand in the way. The God-Builders claim that Prometheuths is not a quasimorph in the usual sense, but something else entirely: “a god we construct”—if we follow his instructions and walk his path.

For now, Prometheuths does not intervene directly. He exists as a series of protocols and voices that scatter through the informational layers of the Solar System. His name is banned on SBN networks. Many claim that Prometheuths already controls the God-Builders, not the other way around. But those who have seen their monstrous bastions or heard the choral chanting at Politburo sessions on Hecate know—for now, everything is going according to plan.
faction.GodBuilders.name: God-Builders
faction.GodBuilders.shortdesc:
General Secretary: Leah, God-Builder: Prometheuths, Politburo
Headquarters: The Red Throne (Hecate)

Public enemy. A revolutionary organization, radical techno-messianists.

faction.Grasshopper.desc:
Grasshopper Tek is a transport giant, the absolute leader in cargo delivery to the Outer System. The corporation specializes in fast and reliable delivery to the outermost frontiers of developed space. It also ensures the safety of transportation, assuring that all logistics specialists are also trained in highly effective defense. The routes used by Grasshopper Tek have more than enough threats, including Unchained Belt and its pirate crews.

The corporation prides itself on its logistics squads, which are ready to repel anyone who encroaches on a convoy. The high demand for cargo protection has spawned a whole division within the corporation dedicated to hiring and training space cowboys who are more interested in space battles than in stable work. Rumor has it that such squads are often used by the corporation far beyond the transportation industry. According to other information, its defense units compete with full-fledged military contractors.

The corporation's motto is: "Cargo is not only delivered, it is delivered safely." Grasshopper Tek provides its services to both small companies and large market players who do not want to risk their transport assets.

The history of Grasshopper Tek began as a corporation that delivered cargo across Earth using suborbital jumps. Such rockets were called "grasshoppers," hence the name of the corporation. Soon after the Great Anarchist Revolution, the corporation saw prospects in the development and transportation of cargo to the Outer System, gradually building a complex logistical infrastructure of intermediate stations, and then beginning to train security squads.
faction.Grasshopper.name: Grasshopper Tek

faction.Hive.desc:
The Hive presents itself as humanity's ark. Its operatives claim that the age of atomized individuals, competing corporations, and private wills has already brought the Solar System to the brink of the abyss. Humanity has proven too fragile, too slow, and too deeply divided to survive the impending nightmare it preferred to ignore. That is why the Hive offers neither reform nor a return to the past, but the next step. It promises humanity's salvation through the creation of a tightly knit, compact ark where the species can survive.

Unlike AnCom, which influenced humanity through imagery, narratives, and entertainment, the Hive exerts direct influence. Its official ideologues claim that personality in its familiar form is merely a temporary shell, born of an era of scarcity, fear, and the struggle for resources. The future, they say, belongs to a new state of humanity: connected, coordinated, and freed from loneliness, doubt, and destructive contradictions.

It is known that the Hive was founded by a certain Order that existed within AnCom. To create the Hive, AnCom comprehensively studied the consciousness-linking technologies used by the Civil Resistance for nearly a century. The Hellstrom Network was deployed within AnCom at lightning speed, as if all the necessary infrastructure had already been prepared in advance. Evidently, AnCom had been preparing such a salvation plan for a very long time. Reports are circulating across SBN that Dr. Hellstrom himself was a secret member of the Order, and that the "Civil Resistance" project served all this time as a proving ground for testing and refining the technology.

The Hive's ideology invites all who seek salvation to join. Its manifesto speaks of synchronization, a unified will, and overcoming humanity's schism. The Hive proclaims itself as humanity’s last hope, the only means to survive the threat of quasimorphosis, which can no longer be ignored or concealed. It is preparing either to face Gagtungr head-on, or to lead humanity to other stars not yet infected by the same contagion that has overtaken the Solar System.

Whatever one may think of the Hive's doctrine, one thing is clear—they have no intention of persuading humanity. They will act.
faction.Hive.name: The Hive
faction.Hive.shortdesc:
Leadership: Coordinator Geoffroi Molay, nine coordination nodes
Headquarters: none.

An organization seeking a path to humanity’s salvation.

faction.PlanetBridge.desc:
PlanetBridge is a leading corporation in the field of engineering and construction technologies. Not every artificial celestial body and station in the Solar System was built by PlanetBridge. But the corporation has worked as a contractor on almost all of them. Moreover, PlanetBridge offers a broad range of services: it makes no difference whether the task involves providing a station with internal infrastructure or developing a transportation network on a planet or satellite. PlanetBridge's motto: "Building bridges between planets".

PlanetBridge's efficiency and engineering are so deeply embedded in the System's transport networks that every third orbital station is rumored to bear traces of its interference and hidden control. Of course, working in outer space carries risks to workers’ lives. The corporation entices employees with promises of huge financial rewards for those willing to participate in building the future.

PlanetBridge also prides itself on its educational programs. The corporation provides general and advanced training in engineering and project management. These programs are in demand both among corporate players seeking to optimize their production and among parents who have taken the risk of having children and want them to have a comfortable future as members of the elite caste of builders of the new world.

The history of PlanetBridge dates back to the early days of space exploration. Its first projects included developing life support systems for space stations and building the first large space colonies. The young corporation gained widespread attention when it purchased the International Space Station from the old states.

faction.PlanetBridge.shortdesc:

faction.RealWare.desc:
RealWare is the bulldog of anarcho-capitalism. The corporation was responsible for the first salvo of the Great Anarchist Revolution. Although it was the failed policies of corrupt governments that led to the dissolution of UN-2, it will always be remembered who struck the first blow, causing the conflict to enter a hot phase. RealWare dropped thermonuclear charges on Geneva. The HIS Day of Fire, which carried out the attack, is now in stationary orbit near Pluto: an eternal reminder of how the liberation of humanity began.

RealWare continues its policy of protecting the AnCap system from any destabilization. The corporation does not engage in propaganda like AnCom and SBN, but in practice proves that a free market is the key to a fair society. The corporation also openly states that its own values are based on contempt for the purely reputational and investment sector of the market. RealWare states that it is ready to send employees to their deaths in the name of protecting the ability of others to do what they want, and thereby work for the benefit of humanity.

Of course, all these declarations do not prevent RealWare from investing in the most profitable sectors of the economy. However, RealWare's real strength is the production of spacecraft, weapons and defense systems.

RealWare has strict discipline and a complex system of internal regulations. The corporation tries to imitate the image of the ancient Roman Empire, which is why it is often called: the Empire. RealWare itself rejects any attempts to compare itself to a nation state and considers this to be Civil Resistance propaganda. This is easy to believe, since the Empire’s warehouses, overflowing with weapons, are the number one target for the rebels.

The corporation is managed by a board of trustees, headed by a Precentor. For 20 years now, the position of Precentor has been held by Ian Fraser. A role model for everyone in the System, a man who has realized the Solar Dream. He started as a janitor at one of the RealWare stations, passed an internal interview for the position of security guard, and then moved up the ranks until he reached the very top. The head of all armed employees of the corporation is the Security Legatus. The position is currently held by Fraser’s recently appointed bruiser Angus Dungeon. Rumor has it that the previous Security Legatus died on Venus while leading a force in a deniable operation against another corporation. Since the Security Legatus has operational control over the real military force, RealWare has a well-known dual power: the duumvirate.

All thenuclear weapons owned by the nation states were transferred by the Hexarchy to RealWare for safekeeping. It is believed that only RealWare is capable of ensuring their safekeeping. The norms of the New Corporate Ethics enshrine this position, as well as the responsibility that RealWare bears for this trust from all participants of the AnCap system.

RealWare’shistory begins amid the chaos of the wars of the mid-21st century. The arms companies, supplying their products to all sides of the conflict at once, found it increasingly difficult to ensure extraterritoriality. So they hired several private armies to protect their property. From the very beginning of this cooperation, the army leadership pursued a policy of entryism in the management of corporations. As a result, one of the armies forced several corporations to unite under a new name. Of course, this led to several internal armed conflicts. The RealWare corporation was truly tempered in fire.
faction.RealWare.name: RealWare

faction.SBN.desc:
Hexarch SBN is the largest operator of information flow routing in the Solar System. SBN means Solar Broadcast Network. At the lower level, SBN is divided into numerous news agencies. Each SBN station forms a separate agency, whose staff of journalists and editors immediately begins to produce news about the station, the celestial body and all nearby routes. In addition, the SBN has technical units that support the network infrastructure. It is no secret that these units consist of highly qualified intelligence officers and decoding specialists. They intercept and analyze all traffic passing through the SBN stations.

It is also worth highlightingthe SBN System Portal. A continuous flow of raw information that the SBN transmits from the AES (Earth). This is an open channel through which all legal (not being public enemies) participants of the AnCap system can send messages. This is how an endless information and news feed is formed. Everyone simply calls this portal the SBN. However, encrypted data can also be transmitted through it. How and what to fish out of the SBN is up to the recipient. Workers in the mines on Mars with outdated PCPUs can only count on an edited official news feed. Rich stations with powerful analytical departments can intercept encrypted contracts for PMCs or mysterious relic transmissions on behalf of the long-destroyed Hive corporation. It was a sensation when, at the end of 2199, a strange message was transmitted through the SBN in the name of a quasimorph, who introduced himself to the entire System as Tezctlan.

All agencies, as well as technical departments, were closed by the SBN board of directors. Strategic decisions are made by the board, with the chairman at the helm. The operational management of the corporation is carried out by the chief executive officer (CEO). The board of directors subjects the CEO's work to strict and constant audit. But it wasn’t always this way.

The history of SBN begins where the history of Earth’s major media conglomerates ends. SBN emerged shortly before the Great Anarchist Revolution, when the heirs of the great visionary of the past, who already owned 75% of all humanity’s media resources, bought up the remaining 25%. SBN took on the burden of coordinating the actions of the revolutionary armies, monitoring the actions of corporations during the GAR, and so on. It was SBN that provided the platform for posting the current version of the New Corporate Ethics, the de facto constitution of the AnCap system.

For 30 long years, the executive director was Maria Ancel, a devoted enthusiast of the news business and the philosophy of information. She reformed the management of SBN so that the board of directors became subordinate to the executive director. Mrs. Ancel and a small circle of her close associates had access to information which they used to direct the activities of SBN. As a result, by the last third of the 22nd century, SBN had de facto become the Hexarchy’s ministry of information. Of course, SBN rejects such an offensive label.

Nine years ago, Maria Ancel was killed in a terrorist attack on SBN. The board of directors immediately reversed her reforms to the CEO position, and Ancel’s place was taken by the docile but highly effective Ally Pally. Nonetheless, the influence of Ancel's legacy is enormous. Monuments to her are erected at SBN stations, and the corporation's management holds distinctive rituals on the day of her death. The true heir to Ancel’s ideas is considered to be the current chairman of the board, Roberto Millner.

SBN policy consists of declared strict subordination to the NCE. It is believed that SBN achieves its goals through cunning manipulation of PMCs and other hexarchs. Even SBN’s security service is extremely small. In his New Year's (2200) address to the AnCap system, Millner called SBN "the herald of a new era of humanity, taking upon itself the heavy burden of bringing the light of truth."

Headquarters: AES (Earth)
